enable_pmp_picker_description: Enables a menu in the editor to pick an associated persona for that room.

if_enabled_you_can_use_shorthands_to_use: If enabled, you can use shorthands to use a Persona for one message only (eg. '✨:test')

create_pmp_description: Create Personas to attach custom profiles to messages.
